input: Research Tesla (tesla.com) for a hedge fund

risks.claim: Autonomy regulatory downside: NHTSA opened an Audit Query on 2026-09-04 into Cybercab self-certification, including compliance without conventional pedals, steering wheel and mirrors. Existing safety standards remain effective pending rulemaking; a compliance challenge could impede deployment. No decision deadline was verified as of 2026-11-10.

Operating leverage is fragile: Q3 2026 revenue was $28.046bn versus $28.095bn a year earlier, while operating income fell to $718m from $1.624bn. A vehicle-volume recovery alone therefore does not demonstrate earnings recovery.

Capital-intensity risk: FY2026 capex guidance remains above $20bn despite the lower threshold; actual nine-month capex was $13.014bn as of 2026-09-30. The investment cycle can absorb operating cash generation even with substantial liquidity.

Related-party concentration: as of 2026-09-30 Tesla had $729m receivable from SpaceX and $648m deferred revenue for unsatisfied Megapack obligations; SpaceX-related Megapack revenue was $221m in Q3 and $626m over the nine months. Collection and delivery exposure accompanies the strategic equity investment.

output.company: Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ: TSLA; tesla.com) — as of 2026-11-10

catalysts.claim: 2026-12-03, 3 p.m. Central: annual shareholder meeting; director elections and advisory executive-compensation vote create a governance and management-commentary catalyst. Confirmed in the proxy available as of 2026-11-10.
2027-01-27 after market close: third-party expected next earnings date, not a Tesla-confirmed date; calendar page updated 2026-11-10. Treat timing as provisional.
2026-11-30: reported expiry of China financing and discount offers for eligible orders; a near-term test of order conversion and incentive persistence, not a confirmed company event.

event_driven.claim: Q2 2026 asset acquisition: an unnamed Super Intelligence hardware company cost $1.95bn in Tesla common stock and equity awards; $1.73bn is subject to service conditions and/or deployment-related performance milestones. No expense for the performance-based awards was recognized through 2026-09-30 because the performance conditions were considered improbable.

As of 2026-09-30, Tesla reported a $2.002bn purchase of SpaceX equity during 2026, originating as xAI preferred equity and converted into SpaceX common stock after March 2026 regulatory approvals; ownership was below 1%. This is a related-party capital-allocation exposure, not an announced takeover of Tesla.

output.research_view: As of 2026-11-10, the key distinction is commercial autonomy progress versus durable cash earnings: Q3 adjusted EPS beat company-compiled consensus, but operating income weakened sharply year over year ([Tesla results](https://ir.tesla.com/_flysystem/s3/sec/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021-gen.pdf)). Watch Cybercab compliance and China domestic demand/incentives before underwriting acceleration; ample liquidity buys execution time, but capital spending remains heavy ([NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/press-releases/investigation-tesla-cybercab-self-certification); [China channel check](https://carnewschina.com/2026/11/09/teslas-china-sales-fall-to-8800-in-october-the-lowest-since-july-2022-as-exports-surge/); [Tesla filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066775/tsla-20260930.htm)).

credit_signals.claim: As of 2026-09-30, cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments totaled $45.447bn; unused committed senior unsecured facilities totaled $30bn. Liquidity is substantial, but unused commitments are not cash.

As of 2026-09-30, debt principal was $9.284bn, with approximately $1.32bn current. The $5.966bn China working-capital facility had contractual maturities spanning October 2026–September 2027; that maturity range does not mean the entire facility is due within the next six months.

September 2026 financing added an undrawn $20bn delayed-draw unsecured term facility maturing September 2029 and $10bn of revolvers: $8bn maturing September 2031 and $2bn maturing September 2027. Term-loan availability steps down after closing; Tesla reported material compliance with financial debt covenants as of 2026-09-30.

alternative_signals.claim: October 2026 China channel check, reported 2026-11-09 using CPCA figures: domestic sales 8,817, down 66.1% year over year; Shanghai exports 59,012, up 66.3%; wholesale sales 67,829, up 10.3%. Export mix makes domestic weakness an incomplete measure of total Shanghai demand.

China pricing/finance signal as of 2026-11-09: trade reporting says a five-year zero-interest offer began 2026-10-30; minimum down payment fell from RMB79,900 to RMB39,900. Eligible-order discounted starting prices were RMB225,500 for Model 3 and RMB259,500 for Model Y, through 2026-11-30.

Q3 2026 company channel commentary: Tesla reported its largest passenger-vehicle backlog in four years, battery availability limiting vehicle volume, and Megafactory Texas beginning production with planned capacity of 50 GWh. Backlog commentary is management-reported; planned capacity is not actual output.

Robotaxi page observed as of 2026-11-10 lists autonomous service in Austin, Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, Miami, Orlando, San Antonio and Tampa. Service availability alone does not establish commercial unit economics.

results_vs_guidance.claim: Latest reported quarter, ended 2026-09-30: revenue $28.046bn, GAAP operating income $718m, GAAP diluted EPS $0.22 and adjusted EPS $0.48; operating cash flow $6.263bn and free cash flow $1.531bn. Results released 2026-10-21.

Q3 2026 versus company-compiled sell-side consensus dated 2026-10-19: revenue $28.046bn versus $28.341bn; GAAP EPS $0.22 versus $0.23; adjusted EPS $0.48 versus $0.45. Revenue/GAAP EPS missed while adjusted EPS beat; these estimates are consensus, not Tesla guidance.

Current FY2026 capex guidance in the Q3 filing is above $20bn, versus above $25bn in the Q2 filing. Actual capex for the nine months ended 2026-09-30 was $13.014bn. No verified numeric quarterly revenue or EPS guidance was available for a like-for-like operating-guidance comparison.

insider_and_ownership.claim: CFO Vaibhav Taneja Form 4 filed 2026-09-09: 6,539 shares issued on RSU vesting on 2026-09-05; 2,605.75 shares automatically withheld and sold on 2026-09-08 at $360.134 for tax obligations. This is tax-related selling, not a clean discretionary bearish signal.

BlackRock Schedule 13G/A signed/filed 2026-10-27 reports 196,348,742 shares, or 4.96%, as of 2026-09-30, with sole voting power over 180,605,472 shares. This is a beneficial-ownership snapshot; no purchase/sale amount is inferred without a comparable prior filing.
